hotspots.name: The Yard Hatch
hotspots.description: The only way in that is not the stair. Bolted, from this side. Whoever used it drew it shut behind him and then sat down in the dark.

hotspots.name: Behind the Crates
hotspots.description: A gap just wide enough to sit in, with the dust disturbed and then smoothed over by somebody who thought of it afterwards. The floorboards above are McGovern's study.

hotspots.name: The Coal Heap
hotspots.description: Half a ton of the wet-burning sort. Nothing is buried in it. You check anyway, and your cuffs will not forgive you.
